comments.text: Same spot other day. I was hitching alone with a sign saying Kangding in chinese. Got a ride in 15 minutes all the way to Chengdu by two dudes from there!

Great spot for going south! First time hitching from there got a ride to Tagong (my friend all the way to Kangding) in literally 2 minutes by a local bus driver that gave us ride for free! The rode is under construction so the traffic is slow and there's a restaurant and heaps of space for cars to turn and pull up

comments.text:
We got dropped on a police checkpoint (our driver was going to Danbe and we to Dawu). 
The Policeman gave us noodles and helped hitched. Since all the cars had to pass the police check they were asking them if they are going to our destination and can take us. We got a ride to Dawu in 30 minutes!

comments.text: Lhasa is boring, and it's hard to hitchhike in Lhasa. I hitchhiked the how 317 road, Lhasa has the worst experience.
